mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in the prior month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that prompt equity investors to anticipate lower corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 2 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through joint demand expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), supply chain bottlenecks ease, boosting corporate profit margins and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior month signals strong labor market health, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 250.0 (indicating high inflation), it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0, or the Rank IC over 2 years is above 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong aggregate demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint demand effect.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 250.0), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals a hawkish monetary policy shift that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 2 years.
